scenes.basis: 25:1 "Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea"; 25:2 "Then the high priest and the principal men of the Jews informed him against Paul"
25:6 "he went down to Caesarea, and on the next day he sat on the judgment seat, and commanded Paul to be brought"
25:13 "King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea, and greeted Festus"; 25:23 "Agrippa and Bernice had come with great pomp, and they had entered into the place of hearing"
